name: view-video
title: View video
description: A muted video that plays while it is mostly in view and rests when it is not, with a pause button that is always there and a poster.
docs: For loops and product demos with no sound: the video is always muted and inline. Give it a poster that matches the first frame, so playback starts without a jump, and a label that says what the clip shows. Pass sources with WebM first and MP4 as the fallback. It plays at half visible (threshold), rests off screen and in a background tab, and a pause you press sticks until you press play. Under reduced motion it never starts by itself. Only metadata loads until the video is a screen away. onPlayingChange tells you when it starts and stops, for a status label or analytics. The control stays a dark disc with a light glyph in every theme, so it reads over any frame.
